video_title: Are The Houston Rockets Legit? | Cooper Flagg’s Leap & Wemby vs America

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: The Chicago Bears have finally found a franchise quarterback
quotes.excerpt: I've never seen the Bears with a real quarterback like a Philip Rivers or a franchise cornerstone.
quotes.quote: It is crazy that pretty much since I've been watching football, the Bears have never had a real quarterback like a Philip Rivers or just a franchise cornerstone. We are not even talking about Tom Brady or Peyton Manning. Just someone who is good for 10 years straight. This has never happened in my lifetime. To see what is happening with them, the coach is all in, and Caleb Williams makes two or three throws every single game that there are only two other people in the entire NFL who can make that throw. It is really dope to see, honestly.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: Houston Rockets' success is a perfect storm of coaching and talent
quotes.excerpt: It looks like a perfect storm of Ime Udoka being in year two, Fred being back, and Kevin Durant.
quotes.quote: They look like the real deal. It looks like a perfect storm of Ime Udoka being in year two, Fred being back helps them a lot, and Kevin Durant hasn't missed a step. I was going through some things and just thinking about Kevin Durant overall after I saw him punch on Gafford's head. It just feels like he has so much juice left in the legs and things are still coming super easy to him. Last year he played 78 games, that was the most games he's played since tearing his Achilles. He is super locked in in Houston.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka needs an offensive coordinator to improve the Rockets' offense
quotes.excerpt: Does Ime Udoka need to bring in an offensive coordinator? It's been years of this guy.
quotes.quote: I was actually starting to have some questions after last year's series against the Lakers like, does Ime Udoka need to bring in an offensive coordinator? Because I feel like it's been years of this guy having some pretty underwhelming offenses. We get it, he coaches the hell out of the defense, he keeps guys accountable on that end of the floor, but in the playoffs, you have to have something approaching consistent, durable offense that's multifaceted and way more dynamic than just spam high screen-and-roll with Kevin Durant and a big.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Smart and Bogdan Bogdanovic provide necessary depth for the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Marcus Smart hit seven threes the other night. They now add Bogdan Bogdanovic as well.
quotes.quote: Marcus Smart hit seven threes the other night. They now add Bogdan Bogdanovic as well, my boy, who I think is still an underrated role player in the league and can come off the bench and really shoot it. I didn't really get the time he spent on the Clippers, I didn't understand why he wasn't getting more run. It looks like he's going to get more run here with Houston. So the Marcus Smart addition helps with their offense already, and he can knock down a couple shots when necessary.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Memphis Grizzlies are a legitimate playoff threat despite rebuild status
quotes.excerpt: The Memphis Grizzlies, who everybody told me is in a rebuild, have jumped out the gates.
quotes.quote: The Memphis Grizzlies, who everybody told me is in a rebuild, which they are, I think even their management would say we're in a rebuild, but I'll be damned if they haven't jumped out the gates 6-0. They've beaten the Kings twice, beaten the Jazz twice, beaten the Warriors, and beaten Portland. Cam Boozer has already become the second-youngest player to ever record a triple-double. Ty Jerome for a moment was leading the league in scoring, he's come back down to earth, but he's still averaging 25.8 points a game. They are doing it with elite defense and offense right now.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine's availability is a major concern for the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: As we record this, Zach LaVine is questionable to play. If LaVine doesn't go, Alex Caruso might.
quotes.quote: As we record this, Zach LaVine is questionable to play. If LaVine doesn't go, Alex Caruso might see 40 shots. He might put up a smooth 40 attempts. When you got two dubs against the Kings, it does pad the win column. But I will say, like you said, the win going to Portland, they beat them by 21 points in Portland. That's a really, really, really good win.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's physicality and playmaking are elite for his age
quotes.excerpt: Not only is this guy super skilled passer, but I saw the first time his physicality.
quotes.quote: Not only is this guy super skilled passer, but I saw the first time his physicality. This dude wants to put his body on people. He wants people to feel him in every single game, and I'm like, man, to be that skilled, to have that level of feel, and you combine that with the physicality that this guy brings, so he's going to plant people on screens, he's going to bang with guys to get that loose ball, to get that extra rebound. It's rare that you get all of those things in the one guy.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren is a future elite player with high basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: I love Chet Holmgren. I see him in the mold as like a future like Derrick White type.
quotes.quote: I love Chet Holmgren. I see him in the mold as like a future like Derrick White type, the kind of guy that you can put on any winning team, he can play with any kind of wing, he can fit his game and mold it to whatever the situation calls for, play super hard all the time. I'm a fan of Jaylen Wells, I like a lot of the young guys on this team. Zach Edey I like a lot, hopefully he can stay healthy enough to actually play 23-25 minutes a game this year.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: The Heat's defensive struggles are a major concern early in the season
quotes.excerpt: The most disappointing thing to me is that these motherfuckers can't stop a nosebleed.
quotes.quote: The most disappointing thing to me is that these motherfuckers can't stop a nosebleed. The defense has just been porous, and to think that a Miami team that everybody, and I'm talking about all of the people that I thought are like some of the smartest basketball minds in the league, like, yo, no, these guys are going to be top-five, top-seven at worst defensively right now to start the season, they are bottom-five in the NBA in defense. Eric Spoelstra has to figure it out because this defensive, these guys were never going to light the world up on offense.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo needs to be more aggressive offensively for the Heat
quotes.excerpt: Bam Adebayo, like, I'm sorry, bro. Like people got on Tyler Herro when he was liking comments.
quotes.quote: Bam Adebayo, like, I'm sorry, bro. Like people got on Tyler Herro when he was liking comments about Bam's deficiencies on offense. Bro, he has to be better than what he's shown. It's been piss-poor. Now they've won two straight after an 0-4 start. Granted at Atlanta, who seems to be trending in the wrong direction, and Indiana, who's without Haliburton, their best player. But Bam has to do something. He's got to contribute on offense. This is like the third straight year he's starting really slow.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg's maturity and skill set are impressive for a 19-year-old
quotes.excerpt: I just wanted to talk about Cooper Flagg, honestly. His start to the season has been unbelievable.
quotes.quote: I just wanted to talk about Cooper Flagg, honestly. His start to the season has been unbelievable. He's in, and I know it gets said on every broadcast, he doesn't turn 20 until December 21st, I think it is, or 19th or something like that. It's December. This kid is 19 years old, and he's playing like a grown-ass man. Now, right now he's being really aggressive about taking threes, and they're not really falling at an incredible rate. He's shooting 27% from three right now, but guess what, he's still shooting 55% overall.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg's defensive playmaking is a key part of his game
quotes.excerpt: The stuff that he did at Duke that got me excited about him was the playmaking on defense.
quotes.quote: The stuff that he did at Duke that got me excited about him was the playmaking on defense. Like, ripping guys, meeting dudes at the cup, getting blocked, starting breaks off, like just the defensive playmaking. He's even got that now. He's averaging a block point two a game, 2.6 steals a game. This guy is just an all-around dynamite, elite, all-NBA level talent, and that is all, bro, he's 19 years old doing this shit. It's crazy.
